svg.title: Supplier–Buyer Agent Collaboration overview
svg.desc: Four numbered steps: approved client, Azure Functions gateway, private Foundry Hosted agent, and Copilot Studio A2A.

text.tspan: Foundry + Copilot Studio A2A | Read the numbered request path from left to right
